name: Seoul style
status: draft 4 for stage 1 (2026-11-27): values match seoul/index.html; the spec, prompt and generated files come in stage 2
touchpoints: motifs for the chart grammar, never the subject of the screen: the ridgelines and the river that frame the city, ink-wash landscape painting, hanok lattice doors lit from inside, dark name boards with white writing, sign-off seals, and the city's own Seoul colours

devices.ridge: Figure 1 and the build section: a distribution drawn as an ink-wash mountain. One mountain a field, all on one scale; along the bottom the days a case took to close (0 to 14 or more), the height is the cases closed on that day. Each day is filled in one of three inks (within 3 days, within the deadline, past it), the foot fades into mist, the ridge past the 7-day deadline is a 4.5px Dancheong-red line with the share closed late written above it like a signpost, and the latest field gets the Morning Yellow sun. On wide cards the title sits in the sky like an inscription on a painting; under 520px the mountains stand two by two.
devices.lattice: Figure 2 and Figure 5: a heatmap drawn as lattice doors on ink black. Figure 2 has three doors (phone, app, counter), a pane an hour (06–22) and a column a day; panes light in five lamp steps against that door's busiest hour, under 8% stays dark; the busiest pane is outlined in white, phone hours short of agents are ringed red. Figure 5 is one wide door of 12 case types by 5 areas with the late cases written in each pane.
devices.stream: Figure 3: a stock drawn as a river. Open cases at the end of each day for four weeks; the width of the stream is the count, a pale wash between two river-blue edges, the dashed banks are the plan, and whatever spills over the banks is filled Dancheong red. Thin lines mark the weeks; the last value and its gap to plan sit where the stream ends.
devices.name-board: KPI row: four name boards, dark ink with a 1px wood inner frame and white serif numbers; change and plan or target on the right, a bullet bar with a white tick for the plan underneath. The board the headline is about gets a Morning Yellow band on top.
devices.seal: Table 1: sign-off as a double-ruled seal: approved in Dancheong red, under review in roof-tile charcoal, on hold dashed

sample.topic: City service requests weekly of Vizney City (a fictional division), week 48 (Nov 23–29, 2026): reports received against plan, cases closed inside the 7-day deadline against a 92% target, open cases against plan, calls answered in 20 seconds against an 80% target, late cases by field, type and area, and actions with sign-off. The area filter (all, Central, Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, Southeast) changes every card. The city, its areas and every number are fictional; no real place, office or figure is used.

card.role: light cards and plots, text on dark boards

line.role: 1px card outlines, the rule under the header

ink.role: titles, values, the selected filter, weekend line, base markers, focus (16.1:1 on the card)

muted.role: labels, subtitles, notes, axis text (5.6:1 on the card, 5.1:1 on the page)

meok.role: ink black: the name boards and the lattice cards

wood.role: door frames and the inner frame of the name boards

giwa.role: Seoul colour roof-tile charcoal: ridge lines, the seal under review

stone.role: Seoul colour stone-wall grey: neutral marks

sun.role: Seoul colour of 2026 Morning Yellow (official sRGB 254/156/0), UI only: the band on the lit name board

river.role: the two edges of the stream in Figure 3 (2.5px lines)

river-text.role: river blue as text: West · East, morning and evening labels, good changes (6.3:1 on the card)

band.role: the water of the stream in Figure 3, a pale wash between the edges

red.role: Seoul symbol colour Dancheong red (sRGB 174/25/50): the number in the headline, the ridge past the deadline, the stream over its banks, the target line, bad changes, Sunday, the approved seal (6.7:1 on the card)

dark-text.role: text and numbers on ink black

dark-good.role: a good change on ink black (8.3:1)

dark-bad.role: a bad change on ink black, the ring around off-hours panes (7.7:1)

focus.role: focus ring, 2px with a 2px offset; #fcfaf5 on dark cards

lead.role: the sun over the latest field, one mark a screen; the official Morning Yellow #fe9c00 moved one step for data

ink.role: Figure 1: days to close in three inks, within 3 days · within the deadline · past it (three steps of the four-step ink ramp); the ridge past the deadline also gets the red line

lamp.role: Figures 2 and 5 on ink black: share of the door's busiest pane (Figure 5: of the grid's); brighter is more, under 8% is an unlit pane

status.role: a good change is river blue, a bad one Dancheong red, always with ▲ ▼ and a sign; on ink black #9ec1ec and #ff9aa5

validation.ink: #bab2a4 · #6a655c · #3a3733 on #fcfaf5 --ordinal: all pass (one hue within 7°, monotone, light end 2.01:1); the four-step ramp #bab2a4 · #948d81 · #6a655c · #3a3733 passes too
validation.lamp: #74501f · #a0661f · #cc8726 · #efb258 · #fde6b3 on #272421 --ordinal --mode dark: all pass (dark end 2.14:1); the number inside each pane is 4.5:1 or more
validation.diverging: arms checked apart --ordinal: the blue arm and #e39aa2 · #cf5d6c · #ae1932 pass; grey midpoint
validation.categorical: for the tool palettes only (the screen names series by ink and position): #2f8f6b · #558bcf · #d16f15 + #a6a39a, all pairs, separation passes (worst CVD ΔE 8.7, normal 15.7); the grey reads grey on purpose (2.42:1)
validation.sun: #fa9800 is 2.1:1 on the card: one mark, always beside the mountain's red or ink signpost, never the only cue
validation.text: on the card: ink 16.1, muted 5.6, charcoal 8.0, river text 6.3, red 6.7; on the page: muted 5.1, red 6.1; on ink black: text 14.9, muted 8.7, axis 7.0, good 8.3, bad 7.7
validation.stream: the water is a wash (#d9e8f3) read by its #558bcf edges (3.4:1 on the card, 2.8:1 on the wash) and by the value written at its end; over the banks #ae1932 against #558bcf: CVD 22.7, normal 30.3
validation.lines: Figure 4: ink #1f1d1a against grey #8c877c (3.4:1 on the card); the grey lines are context and are named in the tooltip and the table

sans.role: body, labels and numbers, one face per language: seoul.go.kr sets Korean in Pretendard Variable and english.seoul.go.kr sets English in Noto Sans

serif.role: display only, in the manner of brush-written boards and Seoul's own Hangang typeface: the headline, the company name, the name-board numbers, summit heights and mountain names, door names, section titles

typography.city-fonts: Seoul's own typefaces (Seoul Hangang, Seoul Namsan) are free to use but not to sell or redistribute, so the sample and the package do not load them as web fonts. A company that installs them on its own machines can set them in Tableau and Power BI

scale.headline: serif 31px/600, line-height 1.3, the number in Dancheong red 700; smaller under 640px
scale.action: 16px/500 under the headline after a red arrow
scale.card-title: 19px/700, the figure number above it 12.5px/700 muted; as an inscription inside Figure 1: serif 18px/600 with a 12.5px subtitle
scale.kpi: label 14px/600; value serif 44px/600 tabular (38px under 1200px), unit sans 17px/600; change 13.5px
scale.section: number serif 15px/700 in red, title serif 24px/600
scale.figures: late share on the ridge serif 16px/700 with 'late' 12.5px under it, field and door names serif 15px/700, axis 11px, pane numbers 12.5px/700, stream end value serif 15px/700

rows: header 60px on hanji: Vizney City in the serif, the report name, the week and its solar term, the area filter, the EN/KO switch
the headline with one red number, then one action line
Figure 1 the ridges | Figure 2 three lattice doors (480px, dark)
01 From report to fix: Figure 3 the stream (1.65fr) | Figure 4 on-time closing over 12 weeks (1fr)

layout.responsive: 1360 and over: Figure 2 at 480px; 1200–1359: 440px; 1024–1199: 400px and section 02 stacks (the table is long). Under 1300 the board's change drops under the value and the solar term leaves the header. Under 1024: figures and rows stack, the header wraps. Under 640: boards 2×2, the ridges stand two by two on one scale, Table 1 becomes one block a row with the seal beside the place.

motion.ridges: days rise left to right, then the ridge line, then the signposts and the sun
motion.panes: panes light up door by door, 14ms apart

tableau.fonts: Tableau Book for text; Noto Sans, Pretendard or the Seoul typefaces only if installed on every viewing machine and the server

measured.seoul-colours: seoul.go.kr/seoul/color.do (updated 2026-02-25): 2026 Morning Yellow sRGB 254/156/0 (#fe9c00), lighting RGB 255/72/0, 'the morning sun over Namsan'; 2025 Green Aurora #00b493; 2024 Sky Coral #f8496c. Seoul Light on City Hall, DDP, Seoul Tower, the bridges. Ten Seoul colours from seoul_color_10.pdf in sRGB: Dancheong red #ae1932, Hangang silver white #e0dfde, flower-wall ochre #d16f15, Seoul sky #558bcf, Namsan green #345f53, palace brown #5f4541, roof-tile charcoal #504e48, stone-wall grey #a6a39a, ginkgo yellow #f6b65a, hemp beige #dcccac (the PDF's web hex values are Adobe RGB and are not used). Citizens may use the Seoul colours for events, facilities, spaces and products
measured.emblem: seoul.go.kr/seoul/emblem.do: the word Seoul drawn as mountain (green), sun (centre) and river (blue), after Jeong Seon's morning sun over Mongmyeok; exclusive colours Dancheong red, blue sRGB 0/121/188 (#0079bc), green sRGB 46/133/60 (#2e853c). The emblem itself is not used
measured.seoul.go.kr: Pretendard Variable 16px body; text #222222, second #616b7e, lines #dedede, dark surface #363743; section titles 40px/700; corners 20px and 30px, pill search box; the 'good' air pill #0d6efd
measured.not-used: SEOUL MY SOUL (pink #ff0a73, yellow #fabf13, blue #0082ff, green #00d778, the heart · ! · smile pictograms): needs an application and the slogan combinations are the city's own. The emblem, logos, slogan, mascot (Haechi), landmark pictograms and photos are not used
measured.read-2026-11-26: for draft 3, read without taking pictures or text: hanok lattice doors and name boards, national-park trail signposts and five-grade trail maps, the Seoul Trail stamp course, the riverside runner bases with lockers; the visiting hours of the hanok village (10–17) follow the published red-zone hours
measured.read-2026-11-27: for draft 4 the same sources serve as motifs only (ridgelines and river, ink-wash painting, hanok lattice and name boards, seals); the sample's subject is an ordinary city service-request report

notice.en: Not an official design of the Seoul Metropolitan Government, and not affiliated with or endorsed by it. A reference style read from the publicly visible design of its website (seoul.go.kr) and public touchpoints such as the Seoul colours, hanok and the city’s landscape of mountains and river; it carries no logo, typeface, photo or data of theirs. Trademarks belong to their owners.
notice.ko: 서울특별시의 공식 디자인이 아니며 제휴·승인 관계가 없습니다. 공개된 웹사이트(seoul.go.kr)와 서울색·한옥·산과 강의 풍경 등 공개된 접점에서 보이는 디자인을 읽어 낸 참고용 스타일이며 로고·서체·사진·데이터는 포함하지 않습니다. 상표는 각 소유자의 것입니다.
notice.why: No naming guideline or set notice was found for describing the city by name; the Seoul colours are offered for citizens' use. The emblem, logos, the SEOUL MY SOUL brand, the mascot, landmark pictograms (KOGL type 4), real place names and figures, and photos are not used
